item.text:
Refactored the core simulation path to be more strongly typed and less repetitive.

The main change is that the grid now stores `Species` directly instead of raw `Object`, which removes several casts and makes field access clearer across the simulation, stats, and view layers in [Field.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R005_module_java/Field.java:7), [SimulatorView.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R005_module_java/SimulatorView.java:194), and [FieldStats.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R005_module_java/FieldStats.java:115). I also extracted small helpers in [Simulator.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R005_module_java/Simulator.java:80) so view refresh and plant season synchronization are no longer inlined in the step loop.

In [Initializer.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R005_module_java/Initializer.java:95), I consolidated duplicated animal-construction logic into helper methods and reset `speciesToEvolveInSimulation` per new run, which prevents state from accumulating across repeated initializations. I also normalized a couple of random calls to use the shared RNG in [Species.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R005_module_java/Species.java:134) and [Animal.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R005_module_java/Animal.java:319).

Verification: `javac *.java` passed. The only compiler note left is the pre-existing unchecked warning in `MenuView.java`.
